prs.title: feat(dashboard): add job replay button
prs.author: harbormaster
prs.body:
Failed jobs can be replayed from the dashboard with one click.

Closes #408

prs.title: fix(worker): avoid double ack after lock loss
prs.author: tidewatcher
prs.body:
When the lock expired mid-job, `complete()` still acked and overwrote the state set by the worker that took the job over.

Fixes #409

prs.title: fix(postgres): tighten queue name handling
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.body:
Embargoed under advisory QSA-2026-03, do not describe in public notes.

SQL injection: the schema name was interpolated into the query text. Now validated against `/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/` in the constructor.

prs.title: Revert "feat(dashboard): add job replay button"
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.body: Reverts #411. The replay endpoint has no permission check yet, so it should not ship like this.

prs.title: ci: split lint and test jobs
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.body: Gives faster feedback on lint errors.
prs.diff:
--- a/.github/workflows/test.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/test.yml
@@ -5,0 +6,3 @@ jobs:
+  lint:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps: [{ run: pnpm lint }]

issues.title: Replay failed jobs from the dashboard
issues.body: Today we have to open a shell to retry a failed job.

issues.title: Job state flips back to completed after takeover
issues.body: A second worker takes over a stalled job, then the first one finishes and overwrites the result.
